records.root_cause: Swap active-liquidity and pair-price evidence exists, but neither pool token is a recognized USD stable quote. The cost-state normalizer returns None. Positive AERO reward conversion also lacks its own five measured pool-state fields.
records.suggested_fix: Add measured, provenance-labelled USD cross-pool pricing and AERO conversion depth; if both raw paths are unavailable, retain fail-closed instead of estimating.

records.root_cause: The production resolver probes only the Initial Slipstream factory. The same exact token pair/tick call returns a live pool from the official Gauges V3 factory, with readable slot0/liquidity and real swaps.
records.suggested_fix: Use the official versioned factory registry, validate token0/token1/tick, and record factory provenance; never treat first non-zero as authoritative without validation.

records.root_cause: The measured price path drives recommended range above 100%; p_lo becomes negative and replay raises ValueError at sqrt(p_lo). The ERROR row is excluded from multiwindow, so horizon/fee/reward/IL/latency remain absent.
records.suggested_fix: Validate range domain before replay and emit an explicit permanent fail-closed reason; do not clamp or replace the measured price path merely to make NetCover calculable.

records.root_cause: The production resolver probes only Initial, while two official later factories both return distinct live pools for the same pair/tick. Both have swaps, so token pair alone cannot identify the DefiLlama pool.
records.suggested_fix: Resolve by verified DefiLlama pool-id/address/factory provenance and reject ambiguity; until mapped, permanent_fail_closed_reason=ambiguous_multi_factory_pool.
